items.prompt: What kind of seat would he like?

items.prompt: Where does he have his boarding pass?
items.hint: Listen when he refuses a paper copy
items.answer: He has it on his phone

items.prompt: How can you ask for a different seat?
items.answer: Example: Can I have a window seat, please?

pages.title: A new gate
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Your gate is different now. Please go to gate eight, not gate six. It’s next to the café. You have time for some water. Keep your passport with you. I’m near the gate. See you there!
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! Your gate is different now. Please go to gate eight, not gate six. It’s next to the café. You have time for some water. Keep your passport with you. I’m near the gate. See you there!
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!

items.answer: Ana’s new gate is gate eight

items.prompt: What should Ana keep with her?
items.answer: Ana should keep her passport with her
